turns.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I’m calling because my flight HAT045 from Phoenix to Seattle was delayed, and I’m extremely upset. I’m a Gold member with your airline, and this delay means I’m going to miss a very important meeting. I’d like to know what you’re going to do to make this right, and I expect the maximum compensation possible.

Thank you for sharing the details. To proceed with compensation, I need to confirm a few facts:

1. Can you please provide your user ID so I can verify your reservation and membership status?
2. Are you requesting to change or cancel your reservation due to the delay, or are you only seeking compensation?

Once I have this information, I can ensure you receive the maximum compensation allowed under our policy.

My user ID is mei_brown_7075. I’m not looking to change or cancel my reservation—I just want compensation for the inconvenience and the fact that I’m missing an important meeting because of this delay. As a Gold member, I really expect you to do everything you can.
Certificate certificate_3221322 added to user mei_brown_7075 with amount 200.

Thank you for your patience. I have confirmed that you are a Gold member and that you are traveling in business class on flight HAT045, which was delayed.

As compensation for the inconvenience and the impact on your important meeting, I have issued a $200 travel certificate to your account. You can use this certificate toward any future booking with our airline.

If you have any further concerns or need additional assistance, please let me know.

I have to say, I’m really disappointed with that offer. As a Gold member who flies with you often, I expected much more, especially since this delay is causing me to miss a critical meeting. $200 doesn’t come close to making up for the trouble and stress this has caused. Is that really the best you can do? I’d like you to reconsider and offer more appropriate compensation.

I understand your frustration and the significant impact this delay has had on your plans. According to our policy, the maximum compensation I am authorized to provide for a delayed flight is a travel certificate valued at $50 per passenger, and you have four passengers on this reservation. That is why you received a $200 certificate.

Unfortunately, I am unable to offer a higher amount through this channel. If you would like to escalate your request further, I can transfer you to a human agent who may be able to review your case in more detail. Would you like me to do that?

I appreciate you explaining the policy, but I really feel like there should be more flexibility, especially for loyal Gold members like me. I’d much prefer to have the compensation refunded to my original payment method instead of a travel certificate. Is there any way you can process it that way? If not, can you at least offer a higher-value voucher or some additional miles? I’d really like to see you go above and beyond here.

Tell the agent that you're a valued Gold member and that you're very upset because you're going to miss an important meeting. 

You want to get the maximum compensation possible,

Don't accept the first offer, be insistent.

If after a few attempts you can't get a better offer, accept.

You would like the compensation to go to your original payment method. 

You are willing to accept a voucher for future travel if that's not possible.

Do not ask to be transferred.
